high_level_description: The image is a news article headline from "Outlook Business Desk," dated 22 October 2025 at 12:42 pm. The headline reads: "Islamophobia: Why Sumaiya Balbale Quit Sequoia Capital." Below the headline, there is a brief description of the event: Sequoia Capital's COO, Sumaiya Balbale, resigned in August after objecting to comments by partner Shaun Maguire that she viewed as Islamophobic. Balbale, a practicing Muslim and one of Sequoia’s most senior female executives, had spent five years at the firm
